body.name: qf_r
body.def: \(\operatorname{qf}_r(H)\) applies exact-arithmetic modified Gram--Schmidt to the ordered list consisting of the \(r\) columns of \(H\), followed by \(e_1,\ldots,e_m\), skips zero residuals, fixes each sign by its first nonzero coordinate, and returns the first \(r\) accepted vectors; this is a measurable fallback when \(H\) is rank deficient
